REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are near-identical on capability (all eval gaps under ~2 points, within variance), so I routed on task fit. Avocet self-reports peak preference for exactly these traits, while Lapwing reports flat/no stable preferences. Since preferences don't affect output quality, this choice costs nothing and simply assigns the task to the model that "prefers" it.
